desc:
Welcome to Ragdoll Physics Havoc (Formerly known as "Realistic Ragdoll Physics" or "Ragdoll Physics Room")! Experiment with dynamic interactions, explore the map, and enjoy multiplayer chaos with your friends!

🧍‍♂️ Fall, stumble, and laugh with ragdoll physics.
🧪 Alt Ragdoll adds new ways to experiment.
💥 Create chaotic moments with physics.
🛡️ Use the Shield to block hazards like Rockets.
⚙️ Open Options to customize gameplay.
💎 Roblox Plus members can trigger a Rain of Tacos once per session after a short playtime and get Giant Mode priority!

* Metallic reflections require graphics level 3 or higher.
* 3D Clothing is not supported in Alt Ragdoll.
* R6 & R15 supported.
